summary.text: Liz Ortega, a Democrat, represents the 20th Assembly District, which covers part of Alameda County, in the California State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Her official website says she grew up in Oakland, built a career in the labor movement including as the first Latina leader of the Alameda County Labor Council, holds a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from the University of Phoenix, and lives in San Leandro.
